tool_args.rationale: The stationary ODE fit missed tolerance, but confirmation did not show chaotic or non-stationary behavior. The expanded archive provides a simpler two-layer inland-hub siphon law with a square-root branch, which uses the observed u_now and s_grad dependence and has only three fitted parameters for eight rows.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight rows already support fitting candidate stationary mechanisms; the main issue is model form, not an obvious lack of observations.
The numerically fitted ODE was refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.0716, above 0.045).
Fresh confirmation strongly refuted this model (RMSE 0.5159).

considered_alternatives.option: Inland-hub siphon with negative leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The positive square-root branch is the concrete alternative selected for this attempt; the negative linear leak branch remains a plausible competing form but is not supported strongly enough to justify more data first.
